detail: Transcribed 2026-09-02 from tactic-mainqa-print-app-prod (git archive holds the full node; serves strategy-household-shared-attachments). Park reason: needs production Firestore data volume, deployed indexes, and browser DevTools observation with real usage (QA seeds cap at 3 public items); migrated 2026-07-05 from the legacy gh main-qa office-hours queue. Checklist: (1) Load-more pagination (was 2724, PR 2715) — with >24 public items, page 1 of / shows exactly the first 24 in stable order (addedAt desc, id desc); Load more appends the next page without duplicates or gaps; the button disappears when exhausted. (2) Composite index + name-cursor adequacy (was 2723) — the two composite indexes (publicDomain+addedAt, memberEmails+addedAt) plus the orderBy(documentId(),'desc')/startAfter(...) cursor form serve the bounded queries in production with no failed-precondition or missing-index error; the emulator auto-creates indexes, so only real Firestore proves this. (3) Exhausted-stream read reduction (was 2762, PR 2761) — the exhausted stream is no longer re-queried per Load-more page in the live app, watched via the Firestore usage/network panel, with no missing or mis-ordered results. (4) Bounded PDF metadata reads (was 2589, PR 2586) — opening a large (>4 MB) PDF via the local-folder flow populates title and page count while reading only a small header/trailer byte range, confirmed by DevTools file-access profiling, not the full file.
subject: mainqa (author-required): Verify print app behavior against production — load-more pagination past 24 items, composite index and name-cursor adequacy, exhausted-stream read reduction, bounded PDF metadata reads
